newsitem.title: GERMANY: Air Canada says Frankfurt no shows are no penalty.
newsitem.headline: Air Canada says Frankfurt no shows are no penalty.

text.p: Air Canada has not yet had to apply any no-show penalties in Germany, its cargo manager Germany, Konrad Bossdorf, said.
No-shows were not a particular problem at Frankfurt airport and was not a subject of controversy with forwarders, he told Reuters.
Air Canada is imposing no-show penalties on weekend cargo shipments from Europe to try to tackle the problem of customers who book space but do not deliver the goods.
"This is a European policy but it does not affect us so much. We hardly ever had no shows in the past," Bossdorf said.
"There has been no need to impose these charges," he added.
Air Canada had informed the German freight forwarders association BSL of its new policy in recent talks, Bossdorf said.
